verdict.rationale: Modal provides official Python, JS, and Go SDKs for Sandboxes (modal-gh-1), with extensive docs covering filesystem access, snapshots, networking, and running commands, plus community evidence of a developer building an agent JS runtime using the SDK via gRPC (modal-comm-2). However, evidence shows no OpenAPI/REST spec (modal-probe-3), and the JS/Go SDKs are explicitly narrower than the primary Python SDK. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of SDK completeness/parity across languages, official API reference beyond CLI docs, broader third-party corroboration of building AI-native agentic apps against the SDK.
